title: Methodological insights into sulfur immobilization techniques on commercial carbon for lithium–sulfur batteries

One of the major challenges in lithium–sulfur batteries is selecting an effective method to immobilize sulfur within the carbon host, as this dictates the cathode architecture and overall electrochemical performance.
